definition: Ashish Vaswani is an Indian computer scientist and entrepreneur.
details: He conducted research at Google Brain, co-founded Adept AI, and co-founder and chief executive officer of Essential AI. As of June 2026, Vaswani, along with Essential AI, was acqui-hired by Nvidia. Vaswani is a co-author of the 2017 paper "Attention Is All You Need", which introduced the Transformer neural network architecture. The Transformer model has been used in the development of subsequent NLP models BERT, ChatGPT, and their successors.

explainer.lead: Ashish Vaswani is an Indian computer scientist.

contributions.name: After Google, Vaswani co-founded Adept AI, a machine learning-focused startup that developed AI agents and tools for software automation.
Vaswani co-founded Essential AI with Niki Parmar in December 2022.

timeline.what: Vaswani completed his engineering in Computer Science from Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra in 2002.
Doctor of Philosophy, University of Southern California
Vaswani's most notable paper, "Attention Is All You Need", was published in 2017.
